questions.prompt: First frost on the ground this morning — the season's first real cold snap. What's your first move?

options.text: Back under the covers. The day can wait ten minutes.
Outside already, clearing things off, mentally running late.
Kettle on first. I'll face the cold once there's tea.
Dressed, keys in hand, already halfway out the door.

questions.prompt: Mid-morning check-in. The cold start is behind you — where's your head now?

options.text: Locked in. I know exactly what's next.
Spinning a little — half excited, half overthinking.
Running on fumes, honestly.
Just going where the day takes me.

questions.prompt: Your evening plans just fell through — friend cancels an hour before. You…

options.text: Feel a quiet relief. Couch night sounds perfect.
Start texting around. The night isn't over yet.
Feel stung — I'd rearranged things for this.
End up restless, not sure what to do with myself.

questions.prompt: Someone else is handling dinner tonight. You just pick the vibe — what sounds right?

options.text: The usual comfort food. No surprises needed.
Doesn't matter what it is — I want people around the table.
Something I've never tried. Surprise me.
Honestly just snacks. I'm grazing tonight.

questions.prompt: Dark by dinner now. What should the evening sound like?

options.text: Near-quiet. Rain sounds or nothing at all.
My fall playlist, loud, singing along.
A podcast — company without the small talk.
Only counts if friends are here making noise too.

questions.prompt: One hour from now — how do you want to feel?

options.text: Settled. Day closed, mind quiet.
Like I actually finished something today.
Lighter — laughing at something stupid.
Soft and unwound, the week off my shoulders.
